returns_note: Returns the effective, camera-limited X position. Retail applies its bounds helper when camera limits are enabled; the desktop translates the PPC selection sequence. Projection and pixel parity remain unverified.

name: Video.getCameraPosY
description: Returns the current camera Y position.
returns_note: Returns the effective, camera-limited Y position. Retail applies its bounds helper when camera limits are enabled; the desktop translates the PPC selection sequence. Projection and pixel parity remain unverified.

name: Video.getCameraPosZ
description: Returns the current camera Z position.
returns_note: Returns the effective, camera-limited Z position. Retail applies its bounds helper when camera limits are enabled; the desktop translates the PPC selection sequence. Projection and pixel parity remain unverified.

name: Video.getCameraRotationAngle
description: Returns the current camera rotation angle.
returns_note: Returns the stored axis-angle rotation in radians. Retail and desktop getters read the corresponding Video state field directly; malformed receiver behavior is not modeled.

name: Video.getCameraRotationX
description: Returns the current camera X rotation component.
returns_note: Returns the stored X component of the camera rotation axis. Retail and desktop getters read the corresponding Video state field directly; malformed receiver behavior is not modeled.

name: Video.getCameraRotationY
description: Returns the current camera Y rotation component.
returns_note: Returns the stored Y component of the camera rotation axis. Retail and desktop getters read the corresponding Video state field directly; malformed receiver behavior is not modeled.

name: Video.getCameraRotationZ
description: Returns the current camera Z rotation component.
returns_note: Returns the stored Z component of the camera rotation axis. Retail and desktop getters read the corresponding Video state field directly; malformed receiver behavior is not modeled.

name: Video.getDefaultPostProcessShader
description: Returns the SHADER handle for Video’s default post-process slot.
returns_note: Returns a SHADER handle for the default post-process slot. The wrapper has no underlying default shader installed.

name: Video.getDeviceHeight
description: Returns the device display height in pixels.
returns_note: Returns the active device height in pixels. Retail initializes it to 600 and copies the configured mode height into it on valid restartVideo calls.

name: Video.getDeviceWidth
description: Returns the device display width in pixels.
returns_note: Returns the active device width in pixels. Retail initializes it to 800 and copies the configured mode width into it on valid restartVideo calls.

name: Video.getFPS
description: Returns the most recently measured frame rate.
returns_note: Returns the frame rate as an integer: single-precision 1000 divided by frame time in milliseconds, truncated toward zero. Runtime timing parity is not verified.

name: Video.getFrameTime
description: Returns the most recently measured frame time.
returns_note: Returns the current main-loop frame time in milliseconds as a float. Retail reads the shared timing manager field; desktop uses its measured loop delta.

name: Video.getGrayscalePerc
description: Returns the grayscale effect percentage.
returns_note: Returns the stored grayscale amount. The setter clamps it to the inclusive range 0 to 1; the final-pixel grayscale effect is not implemented.

name: Video.getNumDrawBuffers
description: Returns the number of allocated draw buffers.
returns_note: Returns the number of live draw-buffer objects tracked by the desktop manager. Retail storage/count parity has not been established.

name: Video.getPostProcessTexture
description: Returns null; post-process texture access is not implemented.
returns_note: Always returns null; post-process texture access is not implemented.

name: Video.getRenderBufferMode
description: Returns -1; render-buffer modes are not implemented.
returns_note: Always returns -1; render-buffer modes are not implemented.

name: Video.getRenderBufferModeTextureID
description: Returns -1; render-buffer modes are not implemented.
returns_note: Always returns -1; render-buffer modes are not implemented.

name: Video.getScreenBithDepth
description: Returns the configured screen bit depth.
returns_note: Returns the modeled screen bit-depth field, initialized to 0. Retail restartVideo stores its optional bit-depth argument in a separate field, so this getter remains 0 in the audited retail path.

name: Video.getScreenHeight
description: Returns the logical screen height.
returns_note: Returns the script-space height calculated as 4 × 0.61 × the configured vertical cell count. Retail frame/view behavior is not pixel-verified.

name: Video.getScreenViewScale
description: Returns the current screen view scale.
returns_note: Returns the stored view-scale float. Retail reads the same Video field; how the scale affects desktop projection is still under compatibility work.

name: Video.getScreenWidth
description: Returns the logical screen width.
returns_note: Returns the script-space width calculated as 4 × 0.61 × the configured horizontal cell count. Retail frame/view behavior is not pixel-verified.

name: Video.getTextShadowSize
description: Returns the current text shadow size.
returns_note: Returns the current text shadow size as a number. Retail reads the stored Video field; the corresponding text-rendering effect has not been identified.

name: Video.getTexture
description: Gets or loads a texture resource and returns its script handle.
returns_note: Retail wraps the resolved resource as a script texture object. The local wrapper returns a Texture object; on a missing or invalid resource it returns the fallback texture.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"path","type":"string","description":"Texture resource path."},{"index":1,"name":"area","type":"int","description":"File area; defaults to `FILEHELPER_AREA_GAMEDATA` (1).","optional":"when omitted"}]
parameters_note: Retail accepts one or two arguments. A retail call site also passes an integer in the first position, but its meaning is not established; the local wrapper requires a string path.

name: Video.getTextureExtX
description: Returns the horizontal texture extent for a texture or texture handle.
returns_note: Returns the texture’s horizontal normalized UV extent. The desktop renderer returns 1.0 when it cannot resolve an extent; retail UV parity is unverified.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"handle_or_texture","type":"int or Texture","description":"Texture handle or Texture object."}]

name: Video.getTextureExtY
description: Returns the vertical texture extent for a texture or texture handle.

parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"handle_or_texture","type":"int or Texture","description":"Texture handle or Texture object."}]

name: Video.getTextureMemFree
description: Returns the currently available texture memory estimate.
returns_note: Returns the renderer-reported free texture-memory estimate in bytes, or 0 when no renderer is available. This desktop estimate has not been matched to retail.

name: Video.getTextWidth
description: Returns the measured width of the supplied text using the current font.
returns_note: Measures text with the current font using the recovered retail byte-based glyph metric formula and float rounding. It returns 0 if no desktop font is selected. No matched retail output corpus has been compared yet.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"text","type":"string","description":"Text to measure."},{"index":1,"name":"scale","type":"number","description":"Numeric multiplier applied to glyph advance, bearing, and width measurements."}]
parameters_note: Retail reads both slots without visible count/type validation. The local wrapper defaults missing text to an empty string and missing scale to zero; malformed-call behavior is not equivalent.

name: Video.isDrawingPhysics
description: Reports whether physics debug drawing is enabled.
returns_note: Returns 1 when the physics-debug flag is set, otherwise 0. Retail uses the flag to enter its physics debug draw path; the desktop overlay is not the retail renderer.

name: Video.isFullScreen
description: Reports whether fullscreen mode is active.
returns_note: Returns the stored fullscreen flag as 1 or 0. Retail initializes it false and restartVideo updates it without making a host display API call.

name: Video.isNeedSetScreenViewScale
description: Reports whether the screen view scale needs to be set.
returns_note: Returns the modeled flag as 1 or 0. Retail reads a byte for which the audited binary has no writer and no constructor initialization; the desktop default false is deterministic and not proven equivalent.

name: Video.isPointInView
description: Tests whether a point lies within the current view.
returns_note: Does not push a result. The current handler writes a warning to stderr and returns success; point-in-view testing is not implemented.

name: Video.isShouldDrawEntities
description: Reports whether Video is configured to draw entities.
returns_note: Returns 1 when entity drawing is enabled, otherwise 0. This reports stored Video state; it does not confirm that a particular frame drew entities.

name: Video.isShowingFPS
description: Reports whether the FPS counter is shown.
returns_note: Returns 1 when the FPS display flag is set, otherwise 0. Retail uses the flag to gate its diagnostic overlay; the matching desktop overlay is not implemented.
